name: refresh
description: Refresh the model list for a provider by hitting its /v1/models (or provider-equivalent) endpoint with the stored credentials. For OAuth-backed providers, ensures a fresh access token first via the OAuth manager's EnsureFreshToken path (handles GitHub Copilot token exchange + ChatGPT Pro near-expiry refresh). Returns the updated model list on success. Replaces the chrome.send 'refreshProviderModels' route.

inputs.name: providerId
inputs.description: Provider id (anthropic / openai / google / ollama / chatgpt-pro / github-copilot / etc.)
